caption: Before Dynamic Forms, every field lives inside one monolithic Details tab — all-or-nothing, driven entirely by the page layout.
Dynamic Forms breaks that same page apart — each field and section becomes its own component on the canvas, placeable and configurable individually.
Once a field is its own component, it can carry its own visibility rule — shown here, a filter that only displays the field when Amount is $1,000,000 or more.

code:
Before Dynamic Forms:
  one page layout = one experience for every user
  conditional field visibility needs Apex or a hack

After Dynamic Forms:
  each field is a component with its own visibility rule
  different sales reps can see different fields,
  same record, same page, zero code
caption: The upgrade is declarative, reversible, and the most-asked-about App Builder feature on the exam.

subtitle: Giving users a shortcut instead of a full record edit.
